statements.impact_statement: The missing recursion depth accounting is in the google.protobuf.Any handling of google.protobuf.json_format. No ONNX protobuf message type contains a google.protobuf.Any field, so parsing ONNX JSON (onnx.load(..., format="json")) never reaches that code; an "@type" key is rejected as an unknown field and nested ONNX messages remain subject to max_recursion_depth.
